lenses.name: Density
lenses.description: People per km² of land. Each local administrative unit's 2021 census population (GISCO LAU) is placed on the hex of its centre, or spread evenly over the hexes within its own radius when it is larger than a hex. Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Kosovo have no local units: only their towns of 15,000+ (GeoNames) are counted there. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Change in the region's population between 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2025 (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). A change beyond ±15% is a break in the series (a census revision), left blank. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of the region's residents on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanind3, NUTS 3). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Seniors
lenses.description: Share of the region's residents aged 65 or over on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Children
lenses.description: Share of the region's residents under 15 on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes (Eurostat demo_r_mlifexp, NUTS 2, latest year published). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.unit: € per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards
lenses.note: GDP is counted where it is produced: regions with many commuters coming in (city centres, Luxembourg) look richer than their residents are.
lenses.description: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (PPS, EU27 = euros at average EU prices), so price levels are comparable across countries (Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp, NUTS 3). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Household income
lenses.description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards (Eurostat nama_10r_2hhinc, NUTS 2): what households have left to spend or save after taxes and with social transfers. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: at risk of poverty or social exclusion
lenses.description: Share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE: below 60% of the national median income, severely deprived, or in a household with very low work intensity), Eurostat ilc_peps11n, NUTS 2. The poverty line is national, so the rate compares people with their own country. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.unit: unemployed among the labour force aged 15-74
lenses.description: Unemployment rate, ILO definition, ages 15-74 (Eurostat lfst_r_lfu3rt, labour force survey, NUTS 2). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Employment rate
lenses.description: Share of people aged 20-64 in employment (Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emprt, NUTS 2). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: University degrees
lenses.unit: share of 25-64 year-olds with tertiary education
lenses.description: Share of people aged 25-64 with tertiary education, ISCED levels 5-8 (Eurostat edat_lfse_04, NUTS 2). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by broadleaf, coniferous or mixed forest (CORINE classes 311-313).

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in crops, vineyards, orchards, olive groves, pastures and mixed farming (CORINE classes 211-244).

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built up: urban fabric, industrial and commercial areas, transport networks, construction sites (CORINE 111-133; green urban areas do not count).

lenses.name: Vineyards
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in vineyards (CORINE class 221). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Olive groves
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in olive groves (CORINE class 223). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Orchards
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in fruit trees and berry plantations (CORINE 222). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.
